All amounts mentioned are in U.S. Dollars.

Active Devices & How We Count Them

iOS: Any user that has launched your app at least once on their device during the monthly billing period.
Web Push: Any user that has visited your website at least once on their device during the monthly billing period.
Android: Any user that has installed or kept your app installed on their device during any point of the monthly billing period.

Users must be registered for notifications (by calling Pushy.register()) before we start to bill you for them.

We're passionate about building the most reliable platform for mission-critical notification delivery, worldwide.

Get to know us better

From humble beginnings in 2015, to delivering push notifications reliably for over 15,000 apps.

We're on a mission to ensure time-critical information makes it to its destination on time, whether it be to save a life, or simply to let you know your taxi has arrived. We believe push notifications are the fastest and most direct communication channel with your users. That’s why we're dedicated to making this channel more robust, helping you get your notifications delivered on time, when they matter most.

Elad Nava
Director at Pushy
Trusted by 15,000+ companies worldwide

We do things a bit differently.

Developer-centric

Being passionate developers, we build quality products that are easy to integrate thanks to simple, straightforward documentation.

Self-funded

Profitable since day one, we've never had to seek investment, which allows us to stay true to our core values without compromise.

Transparent

We strive to make all communication clear and clarify everything upfront, and if things go wrong, offer transparency into any incidents.

Customer first

We wouldn't be here without you. We deeply care about establishing tried-and-true customer relationships, and greatly value your feedback.

Fully remote workforce

We believe meaningful, top-quality work can be done from anywhere in the world, and by people of all races and backgrounds.

Advocates of human rights

We believe every individual is entitled to the access of information, and build solutions that empower people worldwide.
